parameters.jsCode: const item=$input.first().json; const ctx=item.public_case ? item : $('Decide idempotent GitHub publication').first().json; const failed=Boolean(item.error)||ctx.publication_action==='ERROR'; const id=ctx.case_id; return [{json:{...ctx,reply:failed?`Caso ${id} aprobado por decisión humana. La publicación no pudo completarse.`:`Caso ${id} aprobado por decisión humana y enviado a publicación.`}}];
const decision=$('Guard status callback and expiry').first().json; return decision.new_state==='APROBADA_HUMANAMENTE' ? [{json:decision}] : [];

const persisted=$input.first().json; const original=$('Guard status callback and expiry').first().json.case_row; if (persisted.caso_id!==original.caso_id || String(persisted.version_caso)!==String(original.version_caso) || persisted.estado!=='APROBADA_HUMANAMENTE' || persisted.approval_status!=='APPROVED') throw new Error('PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_NOT_PERSISTED'); return [{json:{...persisted,approval_evidence:{caso_id:persisted.caso_id,version_caso:persisted.version_caso,estado:persisted.estado,approval_status:persisted.approval_status}}}];

const row=$input.first().json; let api; try { api=typeof row.api_result_json==='string'?JSON.parse(row.api_result_json):row.api_result_json; } catch { throw new Error('PUBLICATION_API_RESULT_INVALID'); } const artifact=api?.case_artifact; if (!artifact || typeof artifact!=='object' || artifact.caso_id!==row.caso_id || String(artifact.version_caso)!==String(row.version_caso)) throw new Error('PUBLICATION_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH'); return [{json:{...row,case_artifact:artifact}}];

const publicCase=$input.first().json; const row=$('Validate persisted approval for publication').first().json; if (publicCase.case_id!==row.caso_id || String(publicCase.version_caso)!==String(row.version_caso) || publicCase.execution_mode!=='LIVE' || publicCase.publication_authorized!==true || publicCase.fuente?.source_mode!=='BANXICO_SIE_LIVE') throw new Error('PUBLICATION_PUBLIC_ARTIFACT_INVALID'); return [{json:{public_case:publicCase,case_id:row.caso_id,version_caso:row.version_caso}}];

const lookup=$input.first().json; const ctx=$('Validate public artifact identity').first().json; const canonical=value=>Array.isArray(value)?'['+value.map(canonical).join(',')+']':value&&typeof value==='object'?'{'+Object.keys(value).sort().map(key=>JSON.stringify(key)+':'+canonical(value[key])).join(',')+'}':JSON.stringify(value); const wanted=canonical(ctx.public_case); const code=lookup.statusCode||lookup.status||lookup.error?.cause?.response?.status||0; if (code===404 || lookup.message==='Not Found' || lookup.error?.message?.includes('404')) return [{json:{...ctx,publication_action:'CREATE'}}]; if (!lookup.content) return [{json:{...ctx,publication_action:'ERROR',publication_error:'GITHUB_LOOKUP_FAILED'}}]; let existing; try { existing=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(String(lookup.content).replace(/\n/g,''),'base64').toString('utf8')); } catch { throw new Error('GITHUB_PUBLIC_CASE_INVALID'); } if (String(existing.version_caso)!==String(ctx.version_caso)) throw new Error('GITHUB_PUBLIC_CASE_VERSION_CONFLICT'); if (canonical(existing)!==wanted) throw new Error('GITHUB_PUBLIC_CASE_CONTENT_CONFLICT'); return [{json:{...ctx,publication_action:'NOOP'}}];

nodes.name: Gate duplicate before claim
nodes.notes: Configure with lookup result: existing event goes to duplicate response; empty result goes to claim. event_id is unique.

parameters.jsCode: const e=$('Normalize safe Telegram event').first().json,a=$input.first().json,ok=e.private_chat&&String(a.telegram_user_id)===e.telegram_user_id&&String(a.telegram_chat_id)===e.telegram_chat_id&&a.status==='ACTIVE'&&['OWNER','EVALUATOR'].includes(a.role)&&(!a.expires_at||Date.parse(a.expires_at)>Date.now());let next='REPLY',reply='Acceso no autorizado.';if(e.route==='/start'||e.route==='/ayuda')next='HELP';else if(e.route==='/acceso')next='ACCESS';else if(ok&&['/demo','/nuevo'].includes(e.route))next='NEW';else if(ok&&e.route==='/estado')next='STATUS';else if(ok&&e.route==='CALLBACK')next='CALLBACK';return[{json:{...e,access:a,authorized:ok,next,reply}}];

const e=$('Authorize and route').first().json,c=$input.first().json,valid=e.private_chat&&e.args.length===1&&c.status==='ACTIVE'&&!c.used_at&&Date.parse(c.expires_at)>Date.now()&&c.role==='EVALUATOR';return[{json:{...e,code_row:c,access_code_valid:valid,reply:valid?'Acceso temporal habilitado.':'Código no disponible o vencido.'}}];

const e=$('Validate and consume access code').first().json,c=$input.first()?.json||{};const confirmed=c.status==='USED'&&Boolean(c.used_at)&&String(c.used_by_user_id)===String(e.telegram_user_id);return[{json:{...e,code_row:c,consumption_confirmed:confirmed,reply:confirmed?'Acceso temporal habilitado.':'El código no pudo ser consumido o ya no está disponible.'}}];

const g=$('Guard status callback and expiry').first().json;const folio=g.case_row?.caso_id||String(g.args?.[1]||'');let reply='Decisión no autorizada o caso no vigente.';if(g.expired)reply=`El periodo de aprobación del caso ${folio} expiró.`;else if(g.allowed)reply=g.args?.[0]==='APR'?`Caso ${folio} aprobado por decisión humana.`:`Caso ${folio} rechazado por decisión humana.`;return[{json:{...g,reply,reply_markup:null}}];
